name: Matrixify
description:
Matrixify is the engine - the Shopify app trusted for bulk data work by everyone from small stores to large enterprises, handling files up to 20 GB. Claude is the driver - tell it what you need in plain language, and it plans the work, runs the jobs, and reports back.

As an AI agent, Claude does more than run bulk actions:
- Understands your task and picks the right Matrixify templates for it.
- Transforms data from any file format into Matrixify templates - and back.
- Builds export and import jobs, monitors them as they happen, and downloads the results.
- Chains whole workflows, like export-edit-import, from a single request.

Manage every layer of your store data:
- Products, Smart & Custom Collections, Customers, B2B Companies
- Discounts, Draft Orders, Orders, Payouts, Store Credits
- Pages, Blog Posts, Navigation Menus, Redirects, Files
- Metafields, Metaobjects, Translations, Activity, Shop details

What you can do:
- Export any data to Excel, Google Sheets, or CSV - filtered to exactly the items and columns you need.
- Import new data, or update only the fields you want without re-importing everything.
- Convert and import data feeds from suppliers and dropshippers, whatever format they arrive in.
- Migrate entire stores to Shopify from WooCommerce, WordPress, Magento, BigCommerce, Lightspeed, and others - or copy data between Shopify stores.
- Generate custom reports from your store data, just by asking.
- Schedule and auto-repeat jobs, see job history, back up your store data and restore it when needed.

Requires the Matrixify app installed on your Shopify store.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Matrixify to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Matrixify to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.matrixify.app/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Matrixify MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Matrixify lists 16 MCP tools, including matrixify_export_create, matrixify_export_get_setup, matrixify_export_get_setup_filters, matrixify_help_search, matrixify_import_create_from_csv_data, matrixify_import_create_from_url, matrixify_import_get_external_formats, matrixify_import_get_setup, matrixify_import_get_supported_formats, matrixify_import_get_upload_url, matrixify_import_start, and matrixify_import_update.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Matrixify?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Matrixify in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.
Matrixify requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Matrixify is developed by ITissible SIA. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
